_comment: Synthetic air handler (generator ahu_excess_oa, camber.datasets._synthetic_ahu_excess_oa; 0.108, #195) -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: OAT and OA_RH the outdoor temperature (F) and relative humidity (%), RAT and RA_RH the return air's, MAT and SAT the mixed and supply air temperatures (F), SAT_SP the supply-air setpoint (F), OA_DMPR the outdoor-air damper command (%), SA_CFM the supply airflow (cfm), HTG_VLV and CLG_VLV the heating and cooling valve commands (%), SF_STS the supply fan's run status (1 = running), OCC the occupancy point (1 = occupied). The scenario column selects one unit per ingest run and is not a point.
